guideline: All three aspects are expected to be scored from 1 (worst) to 5 (best).
Annotators rate each generated essay on relevance, coherence, and content richness on a 1–5 scale.

Relevance evaluates whether the entire content of the generated essay is semantically relevant to the given writing prompt... Coherence indicates whether the generated essay is logically consistent and reasonable... Content Richness measures the amount of distinct relevant aspects covered in the generated essay.
